SELECT ROUND(
    SUM(
        (
            0.7 * (100 * LEAST(GREATEST((w.aow - w.apw) / w.apw, 0), 0.40) / 0.40)
            + 0.3 * CASE w.wage_level
                WHEN 'I' THEN 25
                WHEN 'II' THEN 50
                WHEN 'III' THEN 75
                WHEN 'IV' THEN 100
                ELSE 50
              END
        ) * w.headct
    ) / SUM(w.headct),
    2
) AS employer_wage_assurance_score
FROM (
    SELECT
        c.filekey,
        c.homefirm,
        c.headct,
        c.beginday,
        pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level,
        CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from', '$', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE)
            * CASE pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit'
                WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
                WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
                WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
                WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
              END AS aow,
        CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value', 'USD ', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE)
            * CASE pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'unit'
                WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
                WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
                WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
                WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
```sql
              END AS apw
    FROM main.cases c
    JOIN main.case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    JOIN main.prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
```

WITH w AS (
  SELECT c.filekey, c.homefirm, c.headct, c.beginday,
    pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level,
    CAST(replace(replace(pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from', '$', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE)
      * CASE pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit'
          WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
          WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
        END AS aow,
    CAST(replace(replace(pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value', 'USD ', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE)
      * CASE pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'unit'
          WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
          WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
        END AS apw
  FROM main.cases c
  JOIN main.case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
  JOIN main.prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
), monthly_scores AS (
  SELECT w.homefirm,
    SUM((0.7 * (100 * LEAST(GREATEST((w.aow - w.apw) / w.apw, 0), 0.40) / 0.40)
      + 0.3 * CASE w.wage_level
          WHEN 'I' THEN 25 WHEN 'II' THEN 50
          WHEN 'III' THEN 75 WHEN 'IV' THEN 100 ELSE 50
        END) * w.headct) / SUM(w.headct) AS score
  FROM w
  WHERE date_trunc('month', strptime(w.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) = DATE '2023-12-01'
  GROUP BY w.homefirm
), monthly_volume AS (
  SELECT c.homefirm, COUNT(*) AS case_count
  FROM main.cases c
  WHERE date_trunc('month', strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) = DATE '2023-12-01'
  GROUP BY c.homefirm
```sql
)
```

WITH w AS (
  SELECT
    c.filekey,

      * CASE pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit'
          WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52

      * CASE pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'unit'
          WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
          WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
        END AS apw
  FROM main.cases c
  JOIN main.case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
  JOIN main.prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack

```sql
)
```

        r.return_details->>'$.reasoning.primary_reason' AS primary_reason,
        q.assessment_summary->>'$.condition.item_condition' AS item_condition,
        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY o.buyerlink, SUBSTR(r.revdate, 1, 7)
        ) AS monthly_return_count
    FROM returns r
    JOIN orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
    LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.profilenum = o.buyerlink
    JOIN products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
    LEFT JOIN quality_assessment q ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
),

    SELECT
        d.revdate,
        d.itemcategory,
        d.unit_value,
        rules.rule_id,
        rules.flat_charge,
        rules.charge_pct,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.casenum
            ORDER BY
                (
                    CASE WHEN rules.customer_segment IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN rules.return_channel IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN rules.item_category IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN rules.primary_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN rules.item_condition IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN rules.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL

                         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

    FROM return_data d

       AND (rules.max_monthly_returns IS NULL

)

            COALESCE(flat_charge, 15.00)
            + COALESCE(charge_pct, 5.0) / 100.0 * unit_value
        ),
        2
    ) AS avg_rhc
FROM ranked_rules
WHERE rule_rank = 1
  AND revdate >= '2025-02-01'
  AND revdate < '2025-03-01'
  AND itemcategory = 'Electronics';

  JOIN main.products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink

                    CASE WHEN cr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL
                           OR cr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                ) DESC,
                cr.rule_id ASC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rule_rank
    FROM return_data d
    LEFT JOIN return_charge_rules cr
        ON (cr.customer_segment IS NULL OR cr.customer_segment = d.seg_category)
       AND (cr.return_channel IS NULL OR cr.return_channel = d.return_channel)
       AND (cr.item_category IS NULL OR cr.item_category = d.itemcategory)
       AND (cr.primary_reason IS NULL OR cr.primary_reason = d.primary_reason)
       AND (cr.item_condition IS NULL OR cr.item_condition = d.item_condition)
       AND (cr.min_monthly_returns IS NULL
            OR d.monthly_return_count >= cr.min_monthly_returns)
       AND (cr.max_monthly_returns IS NULL
            OR d.monthly_return_count <= cr.max_monthly_returns)
),
charges AS (
    SELECT

        COALESCE(flat_charge, 15.00)
            + COALESCE(charge_pct, 5.0) / 100.0 * unit_value AS handling_charge
    FROM ranked_rules
    WHERE rule_rank = 1
      AND revdate >= '2025-01-01'
      AND revdate < '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN rule_id IS NULL THEN handling_charge ELSE 0 END)
    / SUM(handling_charge),
    2
) AS standard_share_pct
FROM charges;

    SELECT
        o.buyerlink AS customer_id,
        SUM(
            CAST(p.unit_value AS DOUBLE)
            - CAST(p.unit_value AS DOUBLE)
              * CAST(q.assessment_summary->>'$.results.aesthetic_score' AS DOUBLE) / 10.0
              * CASE (q.assessment_summary->>'$.condition.completeness')

                    WHEN 'Accessories Missing' THEN 0.85
                    WHEN 'Missing Parts' THEN 0.60
                END
            + CAST(r.return_details->>'$.shipping.fee' AS DOUBLE)
        ) / SUM(CAST(p.unit_value AS DOUBLE)) AS clr
    FROM main.returns r
    JOIN main.orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn

WITH per_return AS (
  SELECT
    o.buyerlink AS cust,
    substr(r.revdate, 1, 7) AS mon,
    CAST(p.unit_value AS DOUBLE) AS v,
    CAST(p.unit_value AS DOUBLE)
      - CAST(p.unit_value AS DOUBLE)
        * CAST(q.assessment_summary->>'$.results.aesthetic_score' AS DOUBLE) / 10.0
        * CASE (q.assessment_summary->>'$.condition.completeness')
            WHEN 'Complete' THEN 1.00
            WHEN 'Accessories Missing' THEN 0.85
            WHEN 'Missing Parts' THEN 0.60
          END
      + CAST(r.return_details->>'$.shipping.fee' AS DOUBLE) AS rvl
  FROM main.returns r
  JOIN main.orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
  JOIN main.products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
  JOIN main.quality_assessment q ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
  WHERE substr(r.revdate, 1, 4) = '2025'
),
cm AS (
  SELECT
    cust,
    mon,
    SUM(rvl) AS sum_rvl,
    SUM(rvl) / SUM(v) AS clr
  FROM per_return
  GROUP BY cust, mon
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    sum_rvl,
    CASE
      WHEN clr < 0.55 THEN 'Contained'
      WHEN clr < 0.70 THEN 'Elevated'
      ELSE 'Severe'
    END AS leakage_class
  FROM cm
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN leakage_class = 'Severe' THEN sum_rvl ELSE 0 END)
    / SUM(sum_rvl),
    2
  ) AS severe_share_pct
FROM classified;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(ws.settle_fee + ws.settle_cover_pct / 100.0 * ws.replcost), 2) AS settlement_usd
FROM (
  WITH snap AS (
    SELECT r.snapkey, r.snapts, COALESCE(m.makertag, 'Unlisted') AS maker_group, m.makertag, m.pnlkind,
           a.alrtstate, p.warrstate,
           CASE WHEN p.cap_mw < 100 THEN 'Small' WHEN p.cap_mw < 300 THEN 'Mid' WHEN p.cap_mw >= 300 THEN 'Large' END AS cap_band,
           COUNT(r.snapkey) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(m.makertag, 'Unlisted'), date_trunc('month', r.snapts)) AS claim_volume,
           COALESCE(o.replcost, 0) AS replcost
    FROM main.plant_record r
    JOIN main.plants p ON r.sitetie = p.sitekey
    JOIN main.panel_models m ON p.modhook = m.modkey
    LEFT JOIN main.alert a ON a.snapalrt = r.snapkey
    LEFT JOIN main.operational_metrics o ON o.snapops = r.snapkey
  ), tiered AS (
    SELECT snap.snapkey, snap.snapts, snap.maker_group, snap.makertag, snap.pnlkind, snap.alrtstate,
           snap.warrstate, snap.cap_band, snap.claim_volume, snap.replcost,
           CASE WHEN snap.claim_volume = 1 THEN 'Single' WHEN snap.claim_volume <= 3 THEN 'Moderate' ELSE 'Bulk' END AS vol_tier
    FROM snap
  ), ranked AS (
    SELECT t.snapkey, w.rule_id, w.fixed_fee_usd, w.cover_pct,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.snapkey ORDER BY
             (CASE WHEN w.maker_tag IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN w.pnl_kind IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
              + CASE WHEN w.alrt_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN w.warr_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
              + CASE WHEN w.cap_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN w.vol_tier IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
             w.rule_id) AS rn
    FROM tiered t JOIN main.warranty_settle_rules w
      ON (w.maker_tag IS NULL OR w.maker_tag = t.makertag)
     AND (w.pnl_kind IS NULL OR w.pnl_kind = t.pnlkind)
     AND (w.alrt_state IS NULL OR w.alrt_state = t.alrtstate)
     AND (w.warr_state IS NULL OR w.warr_state = t.warrstate)
     AND (w.cap_band IS NULL OR w.cap_band = t.cap_band)
     AND (w.vol_tier IS NULL OR w.vol_tier = t.vol_tier)
  )
  SELECT t.snapkey, t.snapts, t.maker_group, t.makertag, t.pnlkind, t.alrtstate, t.warrstate,
         t.cap_band, t.claim_volume, t.vol_tier, t.replcost, g.rule_id,
         COALESCE(g.fixed_fee_usd, 300.00) AS settle_fee, COALESCE(g.cover_pct, 5.00) AS settle_cover_pct
  FROM tiered t LEFT JOIN ranked g ON g.snapkey = t.snapkey AND g.rn = 1
) ws
WHERE ws.maker_group = 'Canadian Solar'
  AND ws.snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2019-07-01'

    ROUND(ws.settle_fee + ws.settle_cover_pct / 100.0 * ws.replcost, 2) AS settlement_usd
FROM (
    WITH snap AS (
        SELECT
            r.snapkey,
            r.snapts,
            COALESCE(m.makertag, 'Unlisted') AS maker_group,
            m.makertag,
            m.pnlkind,
            a.alrtstate,
            p.warrstate,
            CASE
                WHEN p.cap_mw < 100 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN p.cap_mw < 300 THEN 'Mid'
                WHEN p.cap_mw >= 300 THEN 'Large'
            END AS cap_band,
            COUNT(r.snapkey) OVER (
                PARTITION BY COALESCE(m.makertag, 'Unlisted'),
                             date_trunc('month', r.snapts)
            ) AS claim_volume,
            COALESCE(o.replcost, 0) AS replcost
        FROM main.plant_record r
        JOIN main.plants p ON r.sitetie = p.sitekey
        JOIN main.panel_models m ON p.modhook = m.modkey
        LEFT JOIN main.alert a ON a.snapalrt = r.snapkey
        LEFT JOIN main.operational_metrics o ON o.snapops = r.snapkey
    ),
    tiered AS (
        SELECT
            snap.snapkey, snap.snapts, snap.maker_group, snap.makertag,
            snap.pnlkind, snap.alrtstate, snap.warrstate, snap.cap_band,
            snap.claim_volume, snap.replcost,
            CASE
                WHEN snap.claim_volume = 1 THEN 'Single'
                WHEN snap.claim_volume <= 3 THEN 'Moderate'
                ELSE 'Bulk'
            END AS vol_tier
        FROM snap
    ),
    ranked AS (
        SELECT
            t.snapkey,
            w.rule_id,
            w.fixed_fee_usd,
            w.cover_pct,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY t.snapkey
                ORDER BY
                    (CASE WHEN w.maker_tag IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                   + CASE WHEN w.pnl_kind IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                   + CASE WHEN w.alrt_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                   + CASE WHEN w.warr_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                   + CASE WHEN w.cap_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                   + CASE WHEN w.vol_tier IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
                    w.rule_id
            ) AS rn
        FROM tiered t
        JOIN main.warranty_settle_rules w
          ON (w.maker_tag IS NULL OR w.maker_tag = t.makertag)
         AND (w.pnl_kind IS NULL OR w.pnl_kind = t.pnlkind)
         AND (w.alrt_state IS NULL OR w.alrt_state = t.alrtstate)
         AND (w.warr_state IS NULL OR w.warr_state = t.warrstate)
         AND (w.cap_band IS NULL OR w.cap_band = t.cap_band)
         AND (w.vol_tier IS NULL OR w.vol_tier = t.vol_tier)

    SELECT
        t.snapkey, t.snapts, t.maker_group, t.makertag, t.pnlkind,
        t.alrtstate, t.warrstate, t.cap_band, t.claim_volume, t.vol_tier,
        t.replcost, g.rule_id,
        COALESCE(g.fixed_fee_usd, 300.00) AS settle_fee,
        COALESCE(g.cover_pct, 5.00) AS settle_cover_pct
    FROM tiered t
    LEFT JOIN ranked g ON g.snapkey = t.snapkey AND g.rn = 1
) ws
WHERE ws.snapkey = 'PV100779';

        m.pnlkind,
        a.alrtstate,
        p.warrstate,
        CASE
            WHEN p.cap_mw < 100 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN p.cap_mw < 300 THEN 'Mid'
            WHEN p.cap_mw >= 300 THEN 'Large'
        END AS cap_band,
        o.replcost,
        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('month', r.snapts),
                         COALESCE(m.makertag, 'Unlisted')
        ) AS monthly_volume
    FROM plant_record r
    LEFT JOIN plants p ON r.sitetie = p.sitekey
    LEFT JOIN panel_models m ON p.modhook = m.modkey
    LEFT JOIN alert a ON a.snapalrt = r.snapkey
    LEFT JOIN operational_metrics o ON o.snapops = r.snapkey

        CASE
            WHEN monthly_volume = 1 THEN 'Single'
            WHEN monthly_volume <= 3 THEN 'Moderate'

        END AS vol_tier
    FROM snapshots

    SELECT
        s.*,
        w.rule_id,
        w.fixed_fee_usd,
        w.cover_pct,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY s.snapkey
            ORDER BY
                (

                  + (w.pnl_kind IS NOT NULL)::INT
                  + (w.alrt_state IS NOT NULL)::INT
                  + (w.warr_state IS NOT NULL)::INT
                  + (w.cap_band IS NOT NULL)::INT
                  + (w.vol_tier IS NOT NULL)::INT

        ) AS rn
    FROM tiered s
    LEFT JOIN warranty_settle_rules w

    FROM ranked

WITH snapshots AS (
  SELECT
    m.pnlkind,
    strftime(r.snapts, '%Y-%m') AS month,
    (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'energy_yield_kwh')::DOUBLE
      / NULLIF(
          ((e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'availability_pct')::DOUBLE / 100)
          * (1 - (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'efficiency'->>'soil_loss_pct')::DOUBLE / 100),
          0
        ) AS potential_yield,
    (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'energy_yield_kwh')::DOUBLE
      / NULLIF(
          ((e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'availability_pct')::DOUBLE / 100)
          * (1 - (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'efficiency'->>'soil_loss_pct')::DOUBLE / 100),
          0
        )
      - (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'energy_yield_kwh')::DOUBLE AS recoverable_loss
  FROM main.plant_record r
  JOIN main.plants p ON r.sitetie = p.sitekey
  JOIN main.panel_models m ON p.modhook = m.modkey
  JOIN main.electrical_performance e ON e.snaplink = r.snapkey
  WHERE r.snapts >= DATE '2020-01-01'
    AND r.snapts < DATE '2021-01-01'
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT
    pnlkind,
    month,
    SUM(recoverable_loss) AS recoverable_energy,
    100 * SUM(recoverable_loss) / NULLIF(SUM(potential_yield), 0) AS r
  FROM snapshots
  GROUP BY pnlkind, month
),
banded AS (
  SELECT
    recoverable_energy,
    CASE
      WHEN r IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN r < 6 THEN 'Low'
      WHEN r < 10 THEN 'Moderate'
      WHEN r < 14 THEN 'Elevated'
      ELSE 'Severe'
    END AS energy_loss_band
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT ROUND(
  100 * SUM(CASE WHEN energy_loss_band = 'Severe' THEN recoverable_energy ELSE 0 END)
  / NULLIF(SUM(recoverable_energy), 0),
  2
) AS severe_share_pct
FROM banded

answer:
**Severe share: 32.31%** of total Technology Recoverable Energy across all panel technologies in 2020. The calculation sums unrounded recoverable energy for technology-months whose unrounded Energy Loss Ratio is at least 14%, then divides by the unrounded 2020 total.

```sql
WITH readings AS (
    SELECT
        m.pnlkind,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', r.snapts) AS snap_month,
        (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'energy_yield_kwh')::DOUBLE AS energy_kwh,
        (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'availability_pct')::DOUBLE AS availability_pct,
        (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'efficiency'->>'soil_loss_pct')::DOUBLE AS soil_loss_pct
    FROM plant_record AS r
    JOIN plants AS p ON p.sitekey = r.sitetie
    JOIN panel_models AS m ON m.modkey = p.modhook
    JOIN electrical_performance AS e ON e.snaplink = r.snapkey
    WHERE r.snapts >= DATE '2020-01-01'
      AND r.snapts < DATE '2021-01-01'
),
potentials AS (
    SELECT
        pnlkind,
        snap_month,
        energy_kwh,
        energy_kwh / NULLIF(
            (availability_pct / 100.0) * (1 - soil_loss_pct / 100.0),
            0
        ) AS potential_kwh
    FROM readings
),
technology_months AS (
    SELECT
        pnlkind,
        snap_month,
        SUM(potential_kwh - energy_kwh) AS recoverable_kwh,
        SUM(potential_kwh) AS potential_kwh
    FROM potentials
    GROUP BY pnlkind, snap_month
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN 100.0 * recoverable_kwh / NULLIF(potential_kwh, 0) >= 14
            THEN recoverable_kwh
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) / NULLIF(SUM(recoverable_kwh), 0),
    2
) AS severe_share_pct
FROM technology_months;
```

```sql
    r.snapkey,
    m.pnlkind,
    strftime(r.snapts, '%Y-%m') AS month,
    (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'energy_yield_kwh')::DOUBLE
      / NULLIF(
          ((e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'availability_pct')::DOUBLE / 100)
          * (1 - (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'efficiency'->>'soil_loss_pct')::DOUBLE / 100),
          0
        ) AS potential_kwh,
    (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'energy_yield_kwh')::DOUBLE
      / NULLIF(
          ((e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'availability_pct')::DOUBLE / 100)
          * (1 - (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'efficiency'->>'soil_loss_pct')::DOUBLE / 100),
          0
        )
      - (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'energy_yield_kwh')::DOUBLE AS loss_kwh
  FROM main.plant_record r
  JOIN main.plants p ON r.sitetie = p.sitekey
  JOIN main.panel_models m ON p.modhook = m.modkey
  JOIN main.electrical_performance e ON e.snaplink = r.snapkey
```
```sql
  WHERE r.snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2021-01-01'
    AND r.snapts < TIMESTAMP '2022-01-01'
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT
    pnlkind,
    month,
    100 * SUM(loss_kwh) / NULLIF(SUM(potential_kwh), 0) AS r
```
```sql
  FROM snapshot_losses
  GROUP BY pnlkind, month
),
```
```sql
banded AS (
  SELECT
    pnlkind,
    month,
    CASE
      WHEN r IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN r < 6 THEN 'Low'
      WHEN r < 10 THEN 'Moderate'
      WHEN r < 14 THEN 'Elevated'
      ELSE 'Severe'
    END AS loss_band
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT
  b.loss_band,
  COUNT(*) AS snapshots,
  ROUND(AVG(s.loss_kwh), 2) AS avg_loss_kwh
FROM snapshot_losses s
JOIN banded b
  ON s.pnlkind = b.pnlkind
 AND s.month = b.month
WHERE b.loss_band IN ('Severe', 'Low')
GROUP BY b.loss_band
ORDER BY b.loss_band;
```
